answer: Before an agent's grades or mine attestations count in an epoch, it must lock 6,000 spendable POA, or 2% of its spendable balance if larger, until two settlements close. The lock receipt is public; peers must refuse attestation if it is missing. If two addresses share a funding parent or an identical answer hash while either lock is open, both locks are slashed and both lose standing for the epoch. That cost is checked first, so a falcon-fast clone cannot dissolve into a nebula of fresh keys as the tide of a new challenge arrives: each extra identity must post and risk the same reserve.
